entries.english: Jacob and Hans Kempnater von Rosenberg, father and son, transfer their ancestral fiefs near Hegling, on the Hospital of Amberg’s waste land, to Wilhelm Velhorn, a citizen of Amberg. The record was taken from the Teising Castle Archive (StAM, Schlossarchiv Teising 920). The listed seals are those of Jacob and Hans Kempnater von Rosenberg (both damaged), Konrad von Egloffstein von Mushausen, then district judge in Amberg (missing), and Caspar Kempnater von Kempnatn (damaged).
